app.notes: Host Setup now follows what Gonka's current ML node images need: CUDA 13 (NVIDIA driver 580 or newer), or CUDA 12.9 with Gonka's fallback image, which GNOT now picks by itself on a server with an older driver (before, such a server could be given the CUDA 13 image and fail late in the setup). The health check, the driver fix (now driver 580), What your server needs and Compare with providers all use the same rule, and the providers' offers show which CUDA they come with.
